backstory:
Céline, a gifted young wizard, comes from a poverty stricken family of 15. Céline has always been a genius when it comes to magic, at least that is what it appears like to the outside world. In reality, Céline spends at least 8 hours daily studying magic, magic history, magic devices, and anything magic related.


Forced to work on the family farm Céline was content with using the little magic she knew to make farming a faster process. Until one day her family sold her to a nobleman to be able to afford enough food to survive the winter. Upon hearing about this, she ran away from her family and traveled for months surviving off whatever she could make doing odd jobs. Eventually, she ended up in Locholt living on her own in a little shack. She’s not entirely sure exactly where her family farm is, but that doesn’t matter. She’ll never return.


One day when doing reconnaissance around Locholt, Giuseppi found her little shack in the middle of the woods and saw her casting advanced looking spells. Seeing that he could kill two birds with one stone, he offered to let Céline teach his beloved son in exchange for a weekly fee + room and board.


She tends to spend most days never leaving her room reading or doing mini magic experiments. She does the volatile magic experiments in the middle of the woods. Sometimes she’s so absorbed in studying she forgets to eat.
